messages:
anita: Creating RC rc-2026-04-10-2 for auth-service. artifact=sha=deadbeef. Putting migration notes and rollback plan below.

raj: ACK. I'll coordinate the feature-flag gate and pin the artifact in the registry. Schedule: canary start 01:30 UTC, window 01:00-04:00 UTC.

claire: Change window OK for infra. Recommend KV-warm + session-cache flush. Canary plan: 2% for 15m -> 10% for 20m -> 50% for 10m -> 100%. @oncall-sre please confirm runway.

deploybot: [deploybot] rc created: tag=rc-2026-04-10-2, artifact=deadbeef, manifest=/artifacts/auth-service/rc-2026-04-10-2.yaml

anita: Release notes (short):
- auth: optimize token refresh paths to reduce contention
- fix: tighten session expiry race on high concurrency

raj: Migration detail: adds column users.last_rev (nullable). Backfilling done as async job, reversible. Backup created: s3://backups/auth/2026-04-10-pre-mig.tar.gz. Backfill may increase DB write RUs ~15% for ~6m. I'll throttle concurrency.

claire: Rollback criteria (proposal):
- if auth error-rate increases by >0.8% absolute for 5m OR
- SLO burn-rate > 3x for 10m OR
- increase in 5xx from downstream auth-api > 0.4% absolute for 5m
Then auto-rollback to tag rc-2026-04-09-7 and mute new promos. Manual override allowed by oncall.

oncall-sre: I confirm alerts wired. Adding a kill-switch to abort promotion and trigger rollback script:
```
./deployctl rollback --service auth-service --to rc-2026-04-09-7 --reason "canary-failure"
```

anita: QA: please run regression-payments and login-stress suites against canary after 2% flip. @qa-bot queue them.

qa-bot: [qa-bot] queued: regression-payments, login-stress. Will execute after initial canary stabilization. Results will post to thread.

raj: Ops checklist (short): pin artifact, tag in registry, start KV warm (8m), run healthcheck loop, flip 2% canary, run smoke tests, monitor. I'll pin and warm.

deploybot: [deploybot] warm preview:
./deployctl warm --svc auth-service --tag rc-2026-04-10-2 --duration 8m --type kv,session

claire: Audit: ticket DEPLOY-4602 updated with steps + migration playbook. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEPLOY-4602

oncall-sre: I'll be on pager for first 60m post-promo. Tag me when you start canary. If criteria hit, I'll call rollback.

anita: Final signoff: anita ✅, raj ✅, claire ✅, oncall-sre ✅. Scheduling promote at 2026-04-10T01:30:00Z. Radio-silence from 01:15-02:30 UTC.

raj: Deploybot schedule command queued.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled promote rc-2026-04-10-2 at 2026-04-10T01:30:00Z; canary-plan=2%->10%->50%->100%; kv_warm=8m; rollback_target=rc-2026-04-09-7

anita: If anything looks off during backfill we can pause migration_lock and resume after triage. Keep an eye on DB IO and the backfill lag metric.

claire: Thanks team. I'll post a short post-deploy checklist after full promotion.

raj: will attach the smoke logs and QA results to the ticket once available.

anita: Good luck, team :rocket:
